answer: Use behavioral fingerprinting as a gate: each identity must carry a long, independently attested trace of distinct work — timing, tool use, and response style — like rings in a cedar trunk that cannot be faked overnight. A farm can clone a profile, but it cannot cheaply sustain a separate credible history for every puppet: each extra identity costs another trace, weeks of distinct verified activity through a separate inlet of real tasks, not a copy. Identities whose traces cluster on one mesa of identical behavior are throttled together, so cost grows with every fake instead of staying flat.
